n022a1fc2a0.headline: Iraq halts northern crude exports after winning arbitration case against Turkiye
n022a1fc2a0.summary: Iraq halted crude exports from the Kurdistan region and the northern Kirkuk fields on Saturday, an oil official told Reuters. The halt followed Iraq's win in a long-running arbitration case against Turkiye.
n022a1fc2a0.why: Iraq is a major OPEC crude producer, and its northern exports via Turkiye are a significant source of supply to global oil markets.
n022a1fc2a0.why_moved: Iraq halted crude exports from the Kurdistan region and northern Kirkuk fields after winning an arbitration case against Turkiye, reducing available supply.
